lines.en: label tsuneyodorm25:
I knock on Tsuneyo’s door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Tsuneyo 的门，等她应声。

lines.en: I can hear the sound of some video game or something from outside, so it’s probably safe to assume that Molly is also home given that Tsuneyo is...well, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 我在门外就能听见某个电子游戏之类的声音，所以大概可以断定 Molly 也在家——毕竟 Tsuneyo 就是……嗯，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: I honestly can’t even imagine her playing video games.
lines.zh: 我真的想象不出她打游戏的样子。

lines.en: Or...really doing anything apart from cooking or following Molly around.
lines.zh: 或者说……除了做饭和跟着 Molly 转，她真的会做别的事。

lines.en: But hey, I’m sure there has to be at least {i}one{/i} game out there that everyone can enjoy.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我相信世上总该有那么{i}一款{/i}谁都能玩得开心的游戏。

lines.en: : You may enter.
lines.zh: : 你可以进来了。

lines.en: scene black
I open the door and make my way into Tsuneyo’s room to see what she’s up to.
lines.zh: 我推开门走进 Tsuneyo 的房间，想看看她在忙什么。

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame1
And, as it turns out, my assumption from several seconds ago is completely incorrect and Tsuneyo actually {i}is{/i} playing a game.
lines.zh: 结果证明，我几秒钟前的猜测大错特错，Tsuneyo {i}真的{/i}在打游戏。

lines.en: Is this character development?
lines.zh: 这就是所谓的角色成长吗？

lines.en: : Hey, what’s going on? It’s not like you to be spending the night on your computer.
lines.zh: : 嘿，在忙什么呢？你可不像是会整晚泡在电脑前的人。

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian has asked that I train myself in the art of virtual combat.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者要求我修习虚拟战斗之术。

lines.en: : As a junior master of the art of Kendo, I imagined something like this would be very easy.
lines.zh: : 作为剑道的少年高手，我本以为这种事会非常轻松。

lines.en: : But I am currently struggling to even perform the most basic of commands.
lines.zh: : 但我现在连最基本的操作都做不好。

lines.en: : How will I ever show my face around her again if I can not keep up with her character?
lines.zh: : 如果跟不上她的角色，我今后还有什么脸面对她？

lines.en: : Just beat her in real life combat and prove once and for all that playing video games is a waste of time.
lines.zh: : 在现实里的战斗中把她打趴下就行了，一劳永逸地证明打游戏是浪费时间。

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame2
: Can anything be called a waste of time if it is something a person enjoys?
lines.zh: : 只要是让人乐在其中的事，还能叫浪费时间吗？

lines.en: : While I do not appreciate this form of entertainment very much, the Guardian has devoted her life to it.
lines.zh: : 虽然我不太欣赏这种娱乐形式，但守护者把自己的人生都献给了它。

lines.en: : What kind of game would a real, live person actually dedicate their life to anyway?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，什么样的游戏能让一个活生生的人真的为它奉献一生？

lines.en: scene raid1
scene raid2
scene raid3
scene raid4
scene raid5
scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame3
: The name of the game is Raid: Shadow Legends.
lines.zh: : 游戏的名字叫 Raid: Shadow Legends。

lines.en: : Oh. Then forget everything I just said, because Raid: Shadow Legends is the number one mobile game of all time.
lines.zh: : 哦。那把我刚才说的都忘了吧，因为 Raid: Shadow Legends 是有史以来第一的手机游戏。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you were also a Raider, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我没想到你也是个 Raid 玩家啊，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Guess again, bro. Because I’ve been spending a lot of time on this game lately, and I’ve gotta say, the hype is real.
lines.zh: : 再猜一次吧，老兄。因为我最近在这游戏上花了不少时间，我得说，这热度是实打实的。

lines.en: : With over seven characters and graphics, the video game is certainly a game that you play.
lines.zh: : 拥有超过七个角色和画面，这款电子游戏无疑是一款你会去玩的游戏。

lines.en: : You’ve got that right, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 你说得对，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame4
: Ah-
: Are you gasping because I said your name again?
lines.zh: : 你是因为我又喊了你的名字才抽气的吗？

lines.en: : No. I just struggle to breathe every time I am not playing Raid: Shadow Legends, the number one mobile game in all of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 不是。我一不玩 Raid: Shadow Legends 就呼吸困难，这可是整个 Kumon-mi 第一的手机游戏。

lines.en: : Did you know that for every new person who plays Raid: Shadow Legends, there is at least one more person playing Raid: Shadow Legends?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，每多一个人玩 Raid: Shadow Legends，就至少又多一个人在玩 Raid: Shadow Legends？

lines.en: : That...yeah. Yeah, that’s how playing the game would work.
lines.zh: : 那……对。对，玩游戏的逻辑本来就是这样的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame5
: Raid: Shadow Legends is also very easy to learn.
lines.zh: : Raid: Shadow Legends 也非常容易上手。

lines.en: : If a sheltered girl with minimal computer experience like myself can learn how to log in, I’m sure that even the most technologically disadvantaged people out there can also learn.
lines.zh: : 连我这种几乎没碰过电脑、与世隔绝的女孩都能学会登录，我相信就算是外头最不懂科技的人也学得会。

lines.en: : And with right now being a day, it is the best possible time to download the game and press the buttons that cause the game to do things.
lines.zh: : 而现在正好是一天之中，所以这正是下载游戏、按下那些让游戏产生反应的按钮的最佳时机。

lines.en: : Do you have a favorite champion, Tsuneyo? Because I’m really fond of Nekhret the Great in the Undead Hordes faction and his “Unsleeping Aegis” passive ability.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你有最喜欢的英雄吗？我个人特别喜欢亡灵部落阵营的 Nekhret the Great，还有他的“Unsleeping Aegis”被动技能。

lines.en: : I like Mario the Plumber from the Plumber’s Guild. He can jump.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢水管工公会的管道工 Mario。他会跳。

lines.en: : Wow. I didn’t realize there was also a character like that in Raid: Shadow Legends.
lines.zh: : 哇。我不知道 Raid: Shadow Legends 里还有这么个角色。

lines.en: : There wasn’t until recently.
lines.zh: : 以前没有，最近才有的。

lines.en: : As it turns out, Raid: Shadow Legends exhausted the list of possible champions and has now begun taking over other game markets and consuming their characters.
lines.zh: : 看来 Raid: Shadow Legends 已经把可能的英雄名单用光了，于是开始吞并其他游戏市场、吃掉它们的角色。

lines.en: : I would not be surprised if you and I were the next ones in line.
lines.zh: : 如果你我是下一个被吞的，我也不会意外。

lines.en: : Why would either of us get thrown into Raid: Shadow Legends? We’re not characters in a video game and, even if we were, there’s no way a developer like...whoever makes it would approach us.
lines.zh: : 我们俩为什么会被扔进 Raid: Shadow Legends？我们又不是电子游戏里的角色，就算我们是，做这游戏的……不管是谁，也不可能找上我们。

lines.en: : I believe Raid: Shadow Legends is made by EA Sports. It’s inside of the game.
lines.zh: : 我相信 Raid: Shadow Legends 是 EA Sports 做的。它就在游戏里。

lines.en: : I think you butchered their slogan a little, but that’s fine. I’m sure it’s only a matter of time before the developers of Raid catch on to this event and-
lines.zh: : 我觉得你把他们的口号改得有点残，不过没关系。我相信 Raid 的开发者迟早会注意到这件事，然后——

lines.en: scene raid6
: Oh, fuck.
lines.zh: : 哦，操。

lines.en: : Why has everything suddenly gone so dark?
lines.zh: : 为什么一切都突然变得这么黑？

lines.en: : I am scared.
lines.zh: : 我害怕。

lines.en: : It’s probably because you went so off-script and started talking about stuff that isn’t actually in Raid.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你跑题跑得太厉害，开始聊 Raid 里根本不存在的东西了。

lines.en: : Nonsense. There is no way the original developers of titles like-
lines.zh: : 胡说。像那些游戏的原开发者怎么可能——

lines.en: scene raid7
: Oh. The screen changed again.
lines.zh: : 哦。屏幕又变了。

lines.en: : Double fuck.
lines.zh: : 双重操。

lines.en: : I stand corrected. What have we done?
lines.zh: : 我收回刚才的话。我们到底做了什么？

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} haven’t done anything. It’s you and the rest of the girls who keep bringing up copyrighted products and titles.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}什么都没做。是你和其他女孩一直在提那些受版权保护的产品和标题。

lines.en: : I’m just trying to be a likable protagonist.
lines.zh: : 我只是在努力当一个讨人喜欢的主角。

lines.en: : And how is that going for you?
lines.zh: : 那效果如何？

lines.en: : Horribly.
lines.zh: : 糟透了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame6
: Woah.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。

lines.en: : Nevermind what’s on your monitor, Tsuneyo. Tell me more about [[Censored due to DMCA claims].
lines.zh: : 别管你屏幕上是什么了，Tsuneyo。跟我说说更多关于[[因 DMCA 投诉已屏蔽]的事吧。

lines.en: : Oh, god damn it.
lines.zh: : 哦，该死。

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame7
: I suppose the time has come to move on.
lines.zh: : 我想是时候翻篇了。

lines.en: : If we spend the next several minutes continuing to talk about this, more people will cancel their support for Selebus.
lines.zh: : 要是接下来的几分钟我们还继续聊这个，会有更多人取消对 Selebus 的支持。

lines.en: : You’re right. God forbid fourth wall breaking comedy finds its way into a game that is definitely serious 100%% of the time and hasn’t already been adding similar jokes for over one year as of October 8th, 2021.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。老天保佑，打破第四面墙的喜剧可千万别混进一款 100%% 从头到尾严肃、而且截至 2021 年 10 月 8 日已经加了一年多类似笑话的游戏里。

lines.en: : I can see the exit surveys now.
lines.zh: : 我已经能看见退出的调查问卷了。

lines.en: scene raid8
: You know, this world would be a much better place if more people would realize that some things exist just because a creator wants them to.
lines.zh: : 说起来，如果更多人能明白有些东西之所以存在，只是因为创作者想让它存在，这个世界会好得多。

lines.en: : That is correct, Sensei. The entire purpose of art is to express a certain idea or a feeling. And the moment artists let people control what they create, art ceases to be.
lines.zh: : 你说得对，老师。艺术的整个目的就是表达某种想法或某种感受。而一旦艺术家让别人来掌控自己创作的东西，艺术就不再是艺术了。

lines.en: : Shhhh, they’ll call us pretentious again and that hurts our feelings.
lines.zh: : 嘘——他们又要说我们装腔作势了，那会伤到我们的感情。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Instead of continuing this discussion, why don’t we simply wait ten seconds to see what happens?
lines.zh: : 哦，对。与其继续讨论这个，我们何不干脆等十秒钟看看会发生什么？

lines.en: : Good idea. That will also give us an ample amount of time to continue guilt-tripping everyone into giving us their money to fight back against the totally real DMCA claims.
lines.zh: : 好主意。这样我们也有充足的时间继续道德绑架，让大家掏钱来支持我们反抗那些完全真实的 DMCA 投诉。

lines.en: : Sounds good to me, bro.
lines.zh: : 我觉得行，老兄。

lines.en: scene raid9
scene ayhh15
scene ayhh13
scene ayhh12
scene ayhh10
scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame8
: And that is why I do not normally like video games.
lines.zh: : 这就是为什么我平时不喜欢电子游戏。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师？

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. I just feel like we got involved in something really weird that I...am having trouble remembering.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我只是觉得我们卷进了什么非常诡异的事，而我……有点想不起来了。

lines.en: : I have heard you mention several problems involving your memory in the past. Do you believe it could be pertaining to that?
lines.zh: : 我以前听你提过几次跟记忆有关的问题。你觉得会不会跟那个有关？

lines.en: : Nah. I’m sure it’s nothing.
lines.zh: : 不。我肯定没什么事。

lines.en: : But please continue telling me more about your relationship with video games and how it pertains to our meeting tonight.
lines.zh: : 不过请继续跟我说说你和电子游戏的关系，以及这跟我们今晚的见面有什么关联。

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame9
: I believe the Emerald Guardian is experiencing heartbreak for the first time, so I would like to do more things outside of the box to help her feel better.
lines.zh: : 我觉得翡翠守护者正在经历人生第一次心碎，所以我想做一些跳出框架之外的事，让她好受一点。

lines.en: : However, there are not many boxes in this room and the possibilities seemed far too great for me to choose just one.
lines.zh: : 可这房间里没多少盒子，而可能性又太多，我实在挑不出一个。

lines.en: : So, I decided to simply start doing something else she likes so she does not have to always play alone.
lines.zh: : 所以我决定干脆开始做她喜欢的另一件事，这样她就不用总是一个人玩了。

lines.en: : I am very bad, though. So I believe I may have to start trying something else.
lines.zh: : 不过我很笨。所以我想我大概得换点别的试试。

lines.en: : If only she liked more games that did not take place inside of computer screens.
lines.zh: : 要是她喜欢更多不用在电脑屏幕里进行的游戏就好了。

lines.en: : I mean, haven’t you been watching her play that one game she plays with all of the other girls? Why not learn that?
lines.zh: : 我是说，你不是一直在看她跟其他女孩玩那款游戏吗？为什么不学那个？

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame10
: I did. But it seems as if my presence in that game may have caused a bit of a rift since that is when the Guardian’s heart showed its first signs of cracking.
lines.zh: : 我学了。不过看来我在那款游戏里的出现可能引发了一点裂痕，因为守护者的心正是在那时第一次出现了裂开的迹象。

lines.en: : I don’t really get what you mean by that, but I’m sure there are some other {i}actual{/i} games Molly enjoys.
lines.zh: : 我不太明白你是什么意思，但我相信 Molly 肯定还喜欢别的{i}正经{/i}游戏。

lines.en: : Like...what did you have in mind? Board games or like...playing cards or something?
lines.zh: : 比如……你想到了什么？桌游，还是……打牌之类的？

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame11
: Mahjong perhaps?
lines.zh: : 麻将也许？

lines.en: : Mahjong? Isn’t that more for...older people?
lines.zh: : 麻将？那不是更偏向……年纪大一点的人吗？

lines.en: : Possibly.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。

lines.en: : I learned by watching my father play a long time ago.
lines.zh: : 我是很久以前看我父亲打的时候学会的。

lines.en: : It seemed very complicated, but he was always happy whenever he won and very sad whenever he lost.
lines.zh: : 那看起来非常复杂，但他赢的时候总是很开心，输的时候总是很沮丧。

lines.en: : I would imagine it’s because he was gambling.
lines.zh: : 我猜那是因为他在赌钱。

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame12
: To exist is a gamble in itself.
lines.zh: : 存在本身就是一场赌博。

lines.en: : Sure. But not for money.
lines.zh: : 当然。但不是为了钱。

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame13
: I suppose it would have made sense if there was money involved.
lines.zh: : 我想如果牵扯到钱就说得通了。

lines.en: : That would certainly explain all of the money that was on the counter as he played.
lines.zh: : 那确实能解释他打牌时柜台上放着的那堆钱。

lines.en: : ...What else did you think that money could have been?
lines.zh: : ……不然你以为那些钱能是什么？

lines.en: : Noodle money, paid in advance. I do not know.
lines.zh: : 面条钱，预付的。我不知道。

lines.en: : I was [young]and naive and did not think much of it.
lines.zh: : 那时我还[young]又天真，没多想。

lines.en: : Now, I am older and slightly less naive, so I am able to better understand the meaning behind certain situations.
lines.zh: : 现在我长大了，也没那么天真了，所以能更好地理解某些状况背后的含义。

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame14
: My father is likely a gambling addict and I am set to inherit his debt.
lines.zh: : 我父亲很可能是个赌瘾者，而我将继承他的债务。

lines.en: : Now I {i}must{/i} teach the Emerald Guardian to play so I can push that debt onto her instead.
lines.zh: : 现在我{i}必须{/i}教会翡翠守护者打麻将，好把那笔债务转嫁到她身上。

lines.en: : So, your new method of cheering Molly up is to riddle her with debt before she finishes [high_school]?
lines.zh: : 所以你逗 Molly 开心的法子，就是在她[high_school]毕业前让她背上一身债？

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame15
: I do not know what to do, Sensei. It is beginning to feel as if some wounds require nothing but time to heal.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该怎么办，老师。我开始觉得，有些伤口除了时间之外什么也治不好。

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. That’s kind of how it works.
lines.zh: : 我是说……对。事情本来就是这样的。

lines.en: : Having friends is nice and all when they can make you feel more...valid or whatever, but I’ve always believed the best way to get over anything is to let time take control.
lines.zh: : 有朋友当然不错，在她们能让你感觉更……有价值或者什么的时候，但我一直认为，熬过任何事最好的办法就是交给时间。

lines.en: : Sure, it’s a bitch more often than not, but it’s a hell of a lot better than a game.
lines.zh: : 当然，时间多半是个 bitch，但它总比一款游戏好得多。

lines.en: : Right now, Molly’s options are either keep running forever...or wallow in misery until that misery is less...miserable.
lines.zh: : 眼下 Molly 的选择只有两个：要么一直跑下去……要么在痛苦里打滚，直到那份痛苦没那么……痛苦。

lines.en: : Neither of those seem like very good options.
lines.zh: : 这两个选择听起来都不怎么样。

lines.en: : Nope. But what can you do?
lines.zh: : 是啊。可你能怎么办呢？

lines.en: : Apparently nothing.
lines.zh: : 显然什么都做不了。

lines.en: : Exactly. Her problems are her problems.
lines.zh: : 没错。她的问题是她的问题。

lines.en: : It’s nice that you want to help her, but not if you’re going to be busting your ass trying new things that are just making {i}you{/i} feel worse. You know what I mean?
lines.zh: : 你想帮她，这心意很好；但如果你为了这个拼命去尝试新东西，结果只是让{i}自己{/i}更难受，那就不值得了。你懂我的意思吧？

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame8
: I do not think so. Now, I just feel inclined to find something to make you happier as well.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我不懂。现在我只想找点事做，也让你更开心一点。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Because even if I do not like you, I still like you.
lines.zh: : 因为就算我不喜欢你，我也还是喜欢你。

lines.en: : ...What?
: Tell me, is there something you would like to do that would make you feel more significant as a human being?
lines.zh: : 告诉我，有没有什么事能让你觉得自己作为一个人更有意义？

lines.en: : Yes, but I don’t think we’re at that level yet.
lines.zh: : 有，但我觉得我们还没到那一步。

lines.en: : And it would really only make me feel more significant for a short burst of time until I go home and lay down again and it all gets worse.
lines.zh: : 而且那只会让我在短时间内觉得自己更有意义，等我回家躺下之后，一切又会变得更糟。

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame16
: Perhaps I could teach you kendo?
lines.zh: : 也许我可以教你剑道？

lines.en: : What? Why would that be your first choice for “things that will make me feel more significant?”
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么这会是你想到的第一个“能让我觉得更有意义的事”？

lines.en: : Despite your physique, you appear to be weak and fragile.
lines.zh: : 尽管你有着这副体格，你看起来却虚弱又脆弱。

lines.en: : Perhaps, if you could defeat an enemy in combat, you will level up and gain skill points to distribute into various categories like “Happiness” and “Confidence.”
lines.zh: : 也许，如果你能在战斗中击败一个敌人，你就会升级，获得技能点，可以分配到“幸福”和“自信”之类的各个类别里。

lines.en: : I don’t really know much about games nowadays, but I don’t think those are categories you can just put points into.
lines.zh: : 我对现在的游戏了解不多，但我觉得那不是你能随便加点数的类别。

lines.en: : Besides, which “enemies” would I even defeat? Everyone I know likes me.
lines.zh: : 再说，我该去击败哪些“敌人”？我认识的每个人都喜欢我。

lines.en: : Even the people that {i}don’t{/i} like me probably like me. They just need more time to realize it.
lines.zh: : 就连{i}不{/i}喜欢我的人大概也喜欢我。他们只是需要更多时间才能意识到这一点。

lines.en: : What an optimistic way of looking at things.
lines.zh: : 这看法的乐观程度真是惊人。

lines.en: : I’m not really known for my optimism, but I’m also not really known for my kendo and would much rather fake being positive than have to learn something like that.
lines.zh: : 我可不怎么以乐观出名，但我也不以剑道出名，我宁愿假装积极，也不想学那种东西。

lines.en: : Besides, I’m already enrolled in a karate class.
lines.zh: : 而且我已经报名了空手道课。

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame17
: You are learning karate?
lines.zh: : 你在学空手道？

lines.en: : I mean...no. But I {i}am{/i} enrolled.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不。但我{i}报名{/i}了。

lines.en: : And by “enrolled” I mean that I just show up there whenever I want and talk to Ayane.
lines.zh: : 而所谓“报名”，就是我什么时候想去就去那儿，跟 Ayane 说说话。

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame16
: As long as doing that makes you feel less horrible inside, I can accept it.
lines.zh: : 只要那样做能让你心里没那么难受，我就能接受。

lines.en: : I will keep the kendo offer on the table, though.
lines.zh: : 不过剑道的提议我保留。

lines.en: : Nothing makes a person feel better than slaughtering a foe. I am sure you are no exception to that very common rule.
lines.zh: : 没有什么比斩杀一个敌人更能让人心情舒畅的了。我相信你也不会是这条普遍规律的例外。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize the purpose of kendo was to “slaughter.”
lines.zh: : 我还不知道剑道的目的是“斩杀”。

lines.en: : Neither did any of my adversaries in the national competition. That is why they lost.
lines.zh: : 全国大赛上我的对手们也不知道。所以他们输了。

lines.en: : You know...sometimes, I feel like you could secretly kill all of us if you really wanted to.
lines.zh: : 说起来……有时候我觉得，如果你真想的话，可以悄悄把我们全杀掉。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I feel that way as well.
lines.zh: : 有时候，我自己也这么觉得。

lines.en: : Great. That’s not terrifying or anything.
lines.zh: : 好极了。这一点也不可怕。

lines.en: : What is even more terrifying is the prospect of a situation in which I would need to do that.
lines.zh: : 更可怕的是，居然存在需要我那么做的局面。

lines.en: : And on that note, I’m going to go back home and hang out with my [niece]- a person who would definitely not ever kill me.
lines.zh: : 说到这儿，我要回家陪我的[niece]了——她绝对不会杀我。

lines.en: : Everyone else? Maybe. But definitely not me.
lines.zh: : 其他人？也许会。但绝对不是我。

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame12
: I understand.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Thank you for stopping by to talk to me about violence tonight.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你今晚过来跟我聊暴力。

lines.en: : That’s...not really why I came.
lines.zh: : 那……真不是我来的目的。

lines.en: : But it was the end result, which means it will be all I take away from this conversation.
lines.zh: : 但结果就是如此，那么这场对话我只会记住这个。

lines.en: : I do not see how this will help me cheer up the Guardian at all.
lines.zh: : 我看不出这对我哄守护者开心有什么帮助。

lines.en: : Me neither. But, if worse comes to worst, you can always just...slaughter her?
lines.zh: : 我也看不出。不过，万一实在没办法，你总可以……把她斩了？

lines.en: scene tsuneyonumberonemobilegame18
: Sometimes, I believe you to be a machine who only exists to come up with the worst possible answers to things.
lines.zh: : 有时候我觉得你是台机器，存在的唯一目的就是为所有事情想出最烂的答案。

lines.en: : That’s...as good a theory as any, I guess.
lines.zh: : 这……也算是个说得通的理论吧，我想。

lines.en: scene black
: Goodnight, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Ah-
: Goodnight to you as well.
lines.zh: : 也祝你晚安。

lines.en: : If you come up with a good way to assist the Guardian in not feeling sad anymore, please inform me.
lines.zh: : 要是你想出了让守护者不再难过的好办法，请告诉我。

lines.en: : It is my role as her newly appointed squire to keep her in top form.
lines.zh: : 作为她新任命的侍从，让她保持最佳状态是我的职责。

lines.en: : I...will do just that.
lines.zh: : 我……会照办的。

lines.en: I make my way out of the room feeling as if I’d been there for much longer than I actually was.
lines.zh: 我走出房间，感觉自己待的时间比实际上长得多。

lines.en: It’s nice knowing that Tsuneyo is looking out for Molly in regard to the whole Rin thing, but I’m confused about whether or not she knows what’s {i}actually{/i} wrong.
lines.zh: 知道 Tsuneyo 在 Rin 那件事上照顾着 Molly，我挺高兴的，但我搞不清她到底知不知道{i}真正{/i}的问题出在哪。

lines.en: Would Tsuneyo doing something like...learning to play games or teaching Molly mahjong really help her get over heartbreak?
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 去做诸如……学着打游戏，或者教 Molly 打麻将这种事，真的能帮她走出心碎吗？

lines.en: Nothing can be that simple, can it?
lines.zh: 什么事情都不可能那么简单吧？

lines.en: And...if it is that simple, can it really be called heartbreak at all?
lines.zh: 而……如果真那么简单，那还能叫心碎吗？

lines.en: I don’t know why I’m thinking about this right now.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己为什么现在在想这些。

lines.en: I slide my phone out of my pocket and begin to distract myself with porn on the way home.
lines.zh: 我把手机从口袋里掏出来，在回家的路上用色情片分散注意力。

lines.en: Something like this is much easier than...whatever I was doing before.
lines.zh: 这种事可比……我刚才在做的任何事都容易得多。

lines.en: I’ve already forgotten.
lines.zh: 我已经忘了。
